recognize_zh: Ommaya引流液抹片中一段分支的細長管狀組織碎片，內有沿長軸排列的橢圓或梭形內皮細胞核，管腔內含紅血球，這是微血管（vessel）碎片，並非腫瘤細胞團。
features: Branching tubular tissue fragment with a Y-shaped bifurcation
Oval to spindle-shaped endothelial nuclei aligned along the long axis of the tube
Homogeneous smooth nuclear chromatin without atypia or mitoses
Red cells lined up within the lumen of one branch
Otherwise sparsely cellular background with scattered red cells
describe_en: Cytospin of fluid from an Ommaya reservoir tap shows a branching tubular fragment lined by bland oval to spindle-shaped nuclei oriented parallel to its long axis, with red cells aligned within the lumen of one branch. The nuclei show no atypia. The background is sparsely cellular. Findings are consistent with a capillary fragment introduced during the tap, an incidental contaminant that should not be mistaken for tumor cell clusters.

ddx.vs: Tumor clusters are three-dimensional aggregates of cells with enlarged pleomorphic nuclei and high N:C ratio, rather than a branching tube with aligned bland nuclei.
Choroid plexus and ependymal cells form cohesive sheets or papillary groups of cuboidal cells with round nuclei and moderate cytoplasm, not tubular spindle-cell structures.
Hyphae are acellular septate or aseptate tubes without nuclei, whereas this structure contains endothelial nuclei and red cells.
